summary: The War‑Shade Expanse is a battlefield of eternal conflict where fallen warriors rise again as War‑Shades. Discord corruption saturates the land, and Muramite commanders use the region as a proving ground.
history: War‑Shades first manifested when Discord energy reanimated the shadows of slain warriors.
Muramite warlords discovered the region and used it to test their armies.
Echoing March formed from endless spectral footfalls repeating across time.
Discordian Bastion became the Muramite command fortress.
The Shade Crucible emerged as the focal point of War‑Shade creation.
